title: How to Breed 20 Palworld Pals | 3 Easy Combos for Each Pal | Palworld Breeding Guide
description: Twenty Palworld Pals and three verified breeding combos for every one of them - sixty combos in total, so you can always use the parents you already have.

sections.heading: Twenty Pals, three combos each
sections.script: Welcome back to HarryBeast Gaming. Today we have a big Palworld breeding guide: twenty Pals, and for every single one of them, three different breeding combos. Why three? Because the Pal you want might need a parent you have not caught yet. With three options, you can almost always use Pals that are already in your Palbox. Every combo in this video was checked against the PalBreedCalc breeding list and the Palworld one point zero breeding formula, so these are real pairs, not guesses. The basics are simple. Build a Breeding Farm at your base, assign one male and one female parent to it, and keep Cake in the farm's box, because without Cake there are no eggs. Collect the egg, put it in an Egg Incubator, and wait for it to hatch. Grab a pen, or save this video, and let's go.

sections.heading: Arsox and Robinquill
sections.script: First up: Arsox. Combo one: Bushi plus Chikipi. Combo two: Clovee plus Kitsun. Combo three: Foxparks plus Vanwyrm. Any of these three pairs works, so start with the Pals you already have. Put the pair on your Breeding Farm, add a cake, and when the egg hatches in your incubator you get a brand new Arsox. Next: Robinquill. Combo one: Bushi plus Pengullet. Combo two: Incineram plus Lamball. Combo three: Rooby plus Vanwyrm. All three pairs hatch the same Pal, so just use the parents sitting in your Palbox. Put the pair on your Breeding Farm, add a cake, and when the egg hatches in your incubator you get a brand new Robinquill.

sections.heading: Which Pal will you breed first
sections.script: That is twenty Pals and sixty breeding combos. Quick reminder of the most important rules: the two parents must be assigned to your base, the farm needs Cake to make eggs, and eggs hatch in an incubator. If one combo needs a Pal you do not have, just jump to one of the other two. Which of these twenty Pals are you going to breed first? Tell us in the comments, and tell us which Pal you want three combos for next. If this guide helped you, hit like and subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more Palworld breeding guides. Happy breeding, Tamers!
